name: The Margin Nobody Translated
description:
Sera says the last eye rewards patient study. For once she does not pretend to know how long that will take.

Continue enchanting. The local End Remastered configuration enables this chance-based source. Earn End Remastered's cryptic eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
